name: ZEPOSIA
indications_original:
ZEPOSIA is indicated for the treatment of:
                  
                     relapsing forms of multiple sclerosis (MS), to include clinically isolated syndrome, relapsing-remitting disease, and active secondary progressive disease, in adults.
                     moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis (UC) in adults.
contraindications_original: Assessments are required prior to initiating ZEPOSIA. ( 2.1 ) Titration is required for treatment initiation. ( 2.2 ) The recommended maintenance dosage is 0.92 mg orally once daily. ( 2.2 ) The recommended maintenance dosage in patients with mild or moderate chronic hepatic impairment (Child-Pugh class A or B) is 0.92 mg once every other day. ( 2.3 ) If a dose is missed within the first 2 weeks of treatment, reinitiate with the titration regimen. If a dose is missed after the first 2 weeks of treatment, continue treatment as planned. ( 2.4 )
adverseReactions_original:
ZEPOSIA is contraindicated in patients who:
                  
                     In the last 6 months, have experienced a myocardial infarction, unstable angina, stroke, transient ischemic attack (TIA), decompensated heart failure requiring hospitalization, or Class III or IV heart failure
  
   [see
                        
                           Warnings and Precautions (5.3)
                        
                        ]
                     
                     Have the presence of Mobitz type II second-degree or third degree atrioventricular (AV) block, sick sinus syndrome, or sino-atrial block, unless the patient has a functioning pacemaker
  
   [see
   
    Warnings and Precautions (5.3)]
  
   
                     
                     Have severe untreated sleep apnea
  
   [see
   
    Warnings and Precautions (5.3)]
  
   
                     
                     Are taking a monoamine oxidase (MAO) inhibitor
  
   [see
   
    Drug Interactions (7)]
